envelope.text: Sends a get_result request and spins the executor until a reply

why:
reads a finished goal's result into caller storage, blocking on the executor. rclcpp_action's is `async_get_result(goal_handle)`, returning a future of a `WrappedResult`; ours is keyed by goal id because our goals live in a static arena addressed by UUID rather than in an owning handle (see `rust:ActionClient::wait_for_action_server` for the typestate half of the same constraint). `Client::get_result_future` is the future-shaped spelling.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
